full_details: Anne went ahead with the three children. Your father stayed behind the shut shop door. At the church your mother asked who mends your shirts, set your inked forefinger beside your father's alum, and did not speak of the trade. Under the responses she said a short grace you knew, and you did not answer it. Nobody looked at the empty place. At the porch she said it was good you came at Lent and not only wrote it, and she did not say it again. The sword stayed on the nail. At dusk the almanac had the new moon on the day.
one_sentence: You gave your mother your arm, his place at church stayed empty, and you heard her once at the porch.
title: Gave Mother an arm, and heard one sentence at the porch
